description: Helps you decide whether your ICP should change after recent wins and losses. You give your current ICP, recent wins, recent losses and market changes. You get a candidate change for each (an addition to test, a disqualifier to test, an implication to check), a draft of the updated ICP, the roles your ICP does not name, the loss reasons to tag and what to pull from your CRM. It does not compute win rates; check each candidate against your CRM. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of icp_gap_analysis when you need candidate ICP changes from recent wins, losses and market shifts.

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

current_icp.description: Your current ICP definition. Format is text. For example, "manufacturers with 200 to 500 employees".

market_changes.description: Recent market or competitive changes. Format is text. For example, "buyers added procurement review this quarter".

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell, used for sector notes. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

recent_losses.description: Description of recent lost deals. Format is text. For example, "two deals paused after budget review".

recent_wins.description: Description of recent successful customers. Format is text. For example, "finance teams chose the documented exception process".

time_period.description: Time period you are reviewing, in your own words (for example "last quarter"). Format is text.

name: icp_evolution_tracker
title: ICP Evolution Tracker
